cards.name: Lileep
cards.description: In ancient times, it lived in warm seas. It disguised itself as seaweed to ambush its prey and devoured them whole when they got close.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.

cards.name: Cosmoem
cards.description: The king who ruled Alola in times of antiquity called it the "cocoon of the stars" and built an altar to worship it.

cards.name: Lunala
cards.description: Records of it exist in writings from long, long ago, where it was known by the name "the beast that calls the moon."

cards.name: Marshadow
cards.description: It slips into the shadows of others and mimics their powers and movements. As it improves, it becomes stronger than those it's imitating.

cards.name: Blacephalon
cards.description: It slithers toward people. Then, without warning, it triggers the explosion of its own head. It's apparently one kind of Ultra Beast.

cards.name: Onix
cards.description: Burrows at high speed in search of food. The tunnels it leaves are used as homes by Diglett.

cards.name: Nosepass
cards.description: It moves less than an inch a year, but when it's in a jam, it will spin and drill down into the ground in a split second.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Trapinch
cards.description: Its jaws are strong enough to crush rocks but so heavy that it can't get up if it flips over. Sandile seize those moments as their chance.

cards.name: Vibrava
cards.description: It vibrates its wings to generate ultrasonic waves, causing its prey to faint. Then it buries the prey alive in the sand to preserve it.

cards.name: Cradily
cards.description: Normally, it lived on shallow sea shoals. When the tide went out, this Pokémon came up on land to search for prey.

cards.name: Anorith
cards.description: When restored Anorith are released into the ocean, they don't thrive, because the water composition has changed since their era.

cards.name: Armaldo
cards.description: It lived on land and went out into the sea to hunt for prey. Its sharp claws were its greatest weapon.

cards.name: Groudon
cards.description: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.

cards.name: Drilbur
cards.description: It makes its way swiftly through the soil by putting both claws together and rotating at high speed.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Palpitoad
cards.description: When they vibrate the bumps on their heads, they can make waves in water or earthquake-like vibrations on land.

cards.name: Seismitoad
cards.description: It increases the power of its punches by vibrating the bumps on its fists. It can turn a boulder to rubble with one punch.

cards.name: Throh
cards.description: When it tightens its belt, it becomes stronger. Wild Throh use vines to weave their own belts.

cards.name: Pancham
cards.description: It follows Pangoro around like a henchman. When Pancham makes a big mistake, its leaf gets taken away.

cards.name: Tropius
cards.description: The bunches of fruit growing around the necks of Tropius in Alola are especially sweet compared to those in other regions.

cards.name: Pangoro
cards.description: This rowdy Pokémon boasts great physical strength. Many Trainers are also smitten by its lively character.

cards.name: Crabrawler
cards.description: Its hard pincers are well suited to both offense and defense. Fights between two Crabrawler are like boxing matches.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: It stores coldness in its pincers and pummels its foes. It can even smash thick walls of ice to bits!

cards.name: Rockruff
cards.description: As they develop, their disposition grows more violent and aggressive. Many Trainers find them too much to handle and abandon them.

cards.name: Lycanroc
cards.description: It has no problem ignoring orders it doesn't like. It doesn't seem to mind getting hurt at all—as long as it can finish off its opponent.

cards.name: Passimian
cards.description: They use their saliva to stick leaves to their shoulders. You can tell what troop they belong to from the position of the leaves.

cards.name: Sandygast
cards.description: It likes the shovel on its head, so Sandygast will get serious and fight any children who come to take it back.

cards.name: Palossand
cards.description: Each of its grains of sand has its own will. Palossand eats small Pokémon and siphons away their vital essence while they're still alive.

cards.name: Alolan Meowth
cards.description: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

cards.name: Kricketot
cards.description: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.

cards.name: Alolan Grimer
cards.description: There are a hundred or so of them living in Alola's waste-disposal site. They're all hard workers who eat a lot of trash.

cards.name: Alolan Muk
cards.description: There are over a hundred kinds of poison inside its body. Chemical reactions between different poisons are the source of its vitality.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: They're such cowards that they won't hunt alone. When five or so of them get together, they suddenly turn ferocious!

cards.name: Absol
cards.description: The only thing unlucky about Absol is its appearance. It protects fields and warns people of disaster, so one ought to be grateful for it.

cards.name: Pawniard
cards.description: After shredding its prey, it sharpens its blades on a stone by the river. Each Pawniard has its own favorite sharpening stone.

cards.name: Bisharp
cards.description: No matter how strong the Bisharp, it's said that if the blade on its head is chipped, it will retire from its position as the boss.

cards.name: Guzzlord
cards.description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Alolan Sandshrew
cards.description: After fleeing a volcanic eruption, it ended up moving to an area of snowy mountains. Its ice shell is as hard as steel.

cards.name: Alolan Sandslash
cards.description: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Kricketune
cards.description: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: A cunning and terrifying Pokémon, its cuteness makes opponents let down their guard—and then it swallows them whole with its huge jaws.

cards.name: Probopass
cards.description: Although it can control its units known as Mini-Noses, they sometimes get lost and don't come back.

cards.name: Solgaleo
cards.description: Sometimes the result of its opening an Ultra Wormhole is that energy and life-forms from other worlds are called here to this world.

cards.name: Clefairy
cards.description: They're popular, but they're rare. Trainers who show them off recklessly may be targeted by thieves.

cards.name: Alolan Ninetales
cards.description: The reason it guides people all the way down to the mountain's base is that it wants them to hurry up and leave.

cards.name: Azurill
cards.description: A Pokémon that lives by water. It moves quickly on land by bouncing on its big tail.

cards.name: Cottonee
cards.description: To protect itself, it shoots cotton from its body. When it gets wet in the rain, its cotton grows moist and heavy, and it can't move as well.

cards.name: Whimsicott
cards.description: This nuisance sneaks into people's homes, where it hides important things and scatters cotton all over the place.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Deerling
cards.description: Their coloring changes according to the season and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.

cards.name: Flabébé
cards.description: It's not safe without the power of a flower, but it will keep traveling around until it finds one with the color and shape it wants.

cards.name: Floette
cards.description: It raises flowers and uses them as weapons. The more gorgeous the blossom, the more power it contains.

cards.name: Florges
cards.description: It controls the flowers it grows. The petal blizzards that Florges triggers are overwhelming in their beauty and power.

cards.name: Swirlix
cards.description: To entangle its opponents in battle, it extrudes white threads as sweet and sticky as cotton candy.

cards.name: Slurpuff
cards.description: It can distinguish the faintest of scents. It puts its sensitive sense of smell to use by helping pastry chefs in their work.

cards.name: Sylveon
cards.description: Once a fight breaks out, it will unflinchingly charge at dragon Pokémon that are many times larger than itself.

cards.name: Drampa
cards.description: If a child it has made friends with is bullied, Drampa will find the bully's house and burn it to the ground.

cards.name: Sawsbuck
cards.description: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck's horns.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.description: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Jangmo-o
cards.description: It smacks the scales on its head against rocks or against the ground to frighten its opponents. It can also contact its friends with these noises.

cards.name: Hakamo-o
cards.description: It makes noise by clanging its scales together. When the rhythm has reached its peak, Hakamo-o attacks.

cards.name: Kommo-o
cards.description: When it howls after finishing off its prey, the metallic sounds of its celebrating comrades can be heard from all around.

cards.name: Ultra Necrozma
cards.description: This is its form when it has absorbed overwhelming light energy. It fires laser beams from all over its body.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: The question of why only Eevee has such unstable genes has still not been solved.

cards.name: Igglybuff
cards.description: It's always practicing its singing because it wants to improve. Even when it's asleep, it keeps singing in its dreams!

cards.name: Aipom
cards.description: As it did more and more with its tail, its hands became clumsy. It makes its nest high in the treetops.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Ambipom
cards.description: In their search for comfortable trees, they get into territorial disputes with groups of Passimian. They win about half the time.

cards.name: Teddiursa
cards.description: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they are soaked with honey.

cards.name: Ursaring
cards.description: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.

cards.name: Zangoose
cards.description: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.

cards.name: Lillipup
cards.description: This Pokémon has excellent judgment. If it decides it can't defeat an opponent, it immediately turns tail and vamooses.

cards.name: Herdier
cards.description: The longer its black fur grows, the harder and more impervious it gets. Claws and fangs can't easily penetrate it.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

cards.name: Rufflet
cards.description: With its powerful legs and sturdy claws, it can crack even the hard shells of Shellder and pluck out their insides.

cards.name: Braviary
cards.description: The more scars it has on its front, the more heroic it's considered to be. Those with many scars on their back are mocked by the flock.

cards.name: Helioptile
cards.description: They make their home in deserts. They can generate their energy from basking in the sun, so eating food is not a requirement.

cards.name: Rowlet
cards.description: It sends its feathers, which are as sharp as blades, flying in attack. Its legs are strong, so its kicks are also formidable.

cards.name: Heliolisk
cards.description: They flare their frills and generate energy. A single Heliolisk can generate sufficient electricity to power a skyscraper.

cards.name: Stufful
cards.description: It boasts power enough to split large trees in half. The organ on its rear releases an odor that it uses to communicate with others of its kind.

cards.name: Bewear
cards.description: It waves its hands wildly in intimidation and warning. Life is over for anyone who doesn't run away as fast as possible.

cards.name: Type: Null
cards.description: A Pokémon weapon developed for a specific mission, it went berserk during an experiment, so it was cryogenically frozen.

cards.name: Dartrix
cards.description: This narcissistic Pokémon is a clean freak. If you don't groom it diligently, it will stop listening to you.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Decidueye
cards.description: It nocks its arrow quills and shoots them at opponents. When it simply can't afford to miss, it tugs the vine on its head to improve its focus.

cards.name: Buzzwole
cards.description: Although it's alien to this world and a danger here, it's apparently a common organism in the world where it normally lives.

cards.name: Ponyta
cards.description: As a newborn, it can barely stand. However, through galloping, its legs are made tougher and faster.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Rapidash
cards.description: Very competitive, this Pokémon will chase anything that moves fast in the hopes of racing it.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Excadrill
cards.description: It can help in tunnel construction. Its drill has evolved into steel strong enough to bore through iron plates.

cards.name: Steelix
cards.description: Tempered underground under high pressure and heat, its body is harder than any metal.

cards.name: Stoutland
cards.description: It pays no mind to the cold, thanks to its long warm coat. Stoutland in Alola look a little uncomfortable.

cards.name: Flareon
cards.description: If it inhales deeply, that's a sign it's about to attack. Prepare to be hit by flames of over 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit!

cards.name: Slugma
cards.description: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.

cards.name: Magcargo
cards.description: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.

cards.name: Entei
cards.description: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.

cards.name: Torkoal
cards.description: You can tell how it's feeling by the smoke spouting from its shell. Tremendous velocity is a sign of good health.

cards.name: Gloom
cards.description: Smells incredibly foul! However, around one out of a thousand people enjoy sniffing its nose-bending stink.

cards.name: Victini
cards.description: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.

cards.name: Tepig
cards.description: It can deftly dodge its foe's attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.

cards.name: Pignite
cards.description: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.

cards.name: Emboar
cards.description: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.

cards.name: Larvesta
cards.description: When battling opponents, it sprays fire from its five horns. The max temperature of the flames can reach nearly 5,500 degrees Fahrenheit.

cards.name: Litleo
cards.description: When they're young, they live with a pride. Once they're able to hunt prey on their own, they're kicked out and have to make their own way.

cards.name: Pyroar
cards.description: The males are usually lazy, but when attacked by a strong foe, a male will protect its friends with no regard for its own safety.

cards.name: Alolan Vulpix
cards.description: If you carelessly approach it because it's cute, the boss of the pack, Ninetales, will appear and freeze you.

cards.name: Psyduck
cards.description: Using psychokinesis gives it a headache, so it normally passes the time spacing out and doing as little as possible.

cards.name: Golduck
cards.description: Even fast-swimming fish Pokémon can be disabled by Golduck. It brings them to a standstill and seizes them.

cards.name: Vaporeon
cards.description: Clean, clear waters are its usual habitat. When it's about to be attacked by an invading enemy, it dives into the water to hide.

cards.name: Sneasel
cards.description: They will cooperate to steal eggs from the nests of bird Pokémon, but fights break out to determine which one gets to eat the eggs.

cards.name: Weavile
cards.description: One Weavile will trip a Sandshrew and flip it over, and then another Weavile will deal the finishing blow with its sharp claws.

cards.name: Wailmer
cards.description: It swims along with its mouth open and swallows down seawater along with its food. It sprays excess water out of its nostrils.

cards.name: Wailord
cards.description: They eat so many fish Pokémon that when Wailord become too numerous, fishermen have to chase them off.

cards.name: Snorunt
cards.description: It feeds mainly on ice and snow. It's only able to survive in a limited number of places in the warm Alola region.

cards.name: Glalie
cards.description: It freezes its prey and chews them whole. However, it prefers to eat Pokémon like Vanillite that are already frozen.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Tangela
cards.description: Many writhing vines cover it, so its true identity remains unknown. The blue vines grow its whole life long.

cards.name: Spheal
cards.description: They can't swim well yet, and they move much faster by rolling. When they're happy, they clap fins.

cards.name: Sealeo
cards.description: It has a very sensitive nose. It touches new things with its nose to examine them.

cards.name: Walrein
cards.description: It shatters ice with its big tusks. Its thick blubber repels not only the cold, but also enemy attacks.

cards.name: Kyogre
cards.description: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.

cards.name: Piplup
cards.description: It doesn't like to be taken care of. It's difficult to bond with since it won't listen to its Trainer.

cards.name: Prinplup
cards.description: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.

cards.name: Empoleon
cards.description: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.

cards.name: Phione
cards.description: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.

cards.name: Tympole
cards.description: By vibrating its cheeks, it emits sound waves imperceptible to humans and warns others of danger.

cards.name: Ducklett
cards.description: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.

cards.name: Tangrowth
cards.description: It ensnares prey by extending arms made of vines. Losing arms to predators does not trouble it.

cards.name: Swanna
cards.description: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.

cards.name: Black Kyurem
cards.description: This legendary ice Pokémon waits for a hero to fill in the missing parts of its body with truth or ideals.

cards.name: Wishiwashi
cards.description: Wishiwashi assemble in this formation to face off against strong foes. It boasts a strength that earned it the name "demon of the sea."

cards.name: Dewpider
cards.description: When two Dewpider meet, they display their water bubbles to each other. Then the one with the smaller bubble gets out of the other's way.

cards.name: Araquanid
cards.description: It usually passes its time in the water. When its belly is full, it stores its subdued prey in the water bubble on its head.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Its nature is to store up electricity. Forests where nests of Pikachu live are dangerous, since the trees are so often struck by lightning.

cards.name: Raichu
cards.description: As electricity builds up inside its body, it becomes more aggressive. One theory is that the electricity buildup is actually causing stress.

cards.name: Magnemite
cards.description: It's frequently the cause of power outages, which is why some power plants send out electrical signals that it can't stand.

cards.name: Magneton
cards.description: Delicate equipment can malfunction in areas inhabited by Magneton, which send out mysterious electrical signals.

cards.name: Sunkern
cards.description: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.

cards.name: Jolteon
cards.description: Its lungs contain an organ that creates electricity. The crackling sound of electricity can be heard when it exhales.

cards.name: Chinchou
cards.description: Its two antennae glow softly to lure in prey, making it a useful Pokémon for night fishing.

cards.name: Lanturn
cards.description: When the bacteria living inside its antennae absorb Lanturn's bodily fluids, a strong luminescent effect is produced.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Togedemaru
cards.description: When it's surprised or agitated, the 14 fur spikes on its back will stand up involuntarily.

cards.name: Koffing
cards.description: Its thin, balloon-like body is inflated by horribly toxic gases. It reeks when it is nearby.

cards.name: Weezing
cards.description: If one of the twin Koffing inflates, the other one deflates. It constantly mixes its poisonous gases.

cards.name: Natu
cards.description: Although it still can't fly, its jumping power is outstanding. It jumps way up into trees and plucks the buds from the branches.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: It's said that while this Pokémon has the power to predict the future, it's not powerful enough to change the future it sees.

cards.name: Sunflora
cards.description: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon's face become more vivid and lively.

cards.name: Ralts
cards.description: If its horns capture the warm feelings of people or Pokémon, its body warms up slightly.

cards.name: Kirlia
cards.description: The cheerful spirit of its Trainer gives it energy for its psychokinetic power. It spins and dances when happy.

cards.name: Gallade
cards.description: Because it can sense what its foe is thinking, its attacks burst out first, fast, and fierce.

cards.name: Duskull
cards.description: It doggedly pursues its prey wherever it goes. However, the chase is abandoned at sunrise.

cards.name: Dusclops
cards.description: Anyone who dares peer into its body to see its spectral ball of fire will have their spirit stolen away.

cards.name: Dusknoir
cards.description: It is said to take lost spirits into its pliant body and guide them home.

cards.name: Rotom
cards.description: Research continues on this Pokémon, which could be the power source of a unique motor.

cards.name: Woobat
cards.description: Its habitat is dark forests and caves. It emits ultrasonic waves from its nose to learn about its surroundings.

cards.name: Swoobat
cards.description: It shakes its tail vigorously when it emits ultrasonic waves strong enough to reduce concrete to rubble.

cards.name: Golett
cards.description: Its movements are powered by a mysterious energy. It has continued to move since ancient times, so its power may soon run out.

cards.name: Heracross
cards.description: It's proud of its thick horn. In Alola, its biggest rival is Vikavolt, which it's always fighting with.

cards.name: Golurk
cards.description: Some say that ancient people invented Golurk to serve as a laborer. It follows its master's orders faithfully.

cards.name: Skrelp
cards.description: It vanishes into seaweed and remains perfectly still to avoid attacks from large Pokémon. Rotten seaweed is its main food source.

cards.name: Dragalge
cards.description: This vicious Pokémon sprays a poisonous liquid on opponents that come near. For whatever reason, it gets along really well with Dhelmise.

cards.name: Phantump
cards.description: By imitating the voice of a child, it causes people to get hopelessly lost deep in the forest. It's trying to make friends with them.

cards.name: Trevenant
cards.description: It's feared as a ghost of the forest. Lumberjacks bring along Fire types, which Trevenant hates, when they enter the forest.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Mimikyu
cards.description: Although it's a quiet, lonely Pokémon, if you try to look at what's under its rag, it will become agitated and resist violently.

cards.name: Dhelmise
cards.description: It wraps its prey in green seaweed and sucks away their vitality. It only likes to go after big prey like Wailord.

cards.name: Cosmog
cards.description: Even though its helpless, gaseous body can be blown away by the slightest breeze, it doesn't seem to care.
